Our story

Every child needs someone in their corner.

A safe place to sleep. Someone who notices when you’ve had a hard day. A chance to go to school and keep learning.

Haven of Peace Home has provided care and education at the WEC campus in Kibaha since 2008. WIPAHS helps children build the confidence and skills they’ll carry into adulthood.

Your monthly gift helps provide a safe home, schooling, meals, and dependable care.

Your questions

Know where your gift goes.

Have another question?

Talk to WIPAHS →
How much does sponsorship cost?

Sponsorship costs USD 120 per month. It supports accommodation, education, clothing, medical care and emotional support.

How does sponsorship work?

Start with WIPAHS’s orphan sponsorship programme. The team can explain current matching and payment arrangements, including whether you can support a child through the home without selecting a profile.

Can I pause or cancel a monthly gift?

Ask WIPAHS how to change or stop a recurring gift before setting it up. The process depends on the payment arrangement.

Will I receive updates?

Explore the photo journal for publicly shared activities. Ask WIPAHS what updates are available to sponsors and how often they are shared.

How is each child’s privacy protected?

We share children’s information only with consent. Ask WIPAHS about its safeguarding and sponsor contact arrangements.

Can I give a different amount?

Choose “Give once” to plan a gift of your choice. WIPAHS confirms available amounts, currencies and payment routes.

Can I volunteer or visit the home?

Contact WIPAHS to discuss opportunities. Arrange any visits or volunteering with the team in advance.
